name: Ryojoku no Dilemma
source:
The queen Eltansia with the help of loyal soldieress Letania successfully escape their castle under capture, only to be caught and sold on the black market among the commonfolk! 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033499.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
艾尔坦西亚女王在忠诚的女战士蕾塔妮亚的帮助下成功逃出了被占领的城堡，却被抓住并在黑市上被卖给了平民百姓！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033499.html]DLsite English[/url]]
